Add your friends

Upload profile pictures (PFPs) of your favorite CT friends. Add as many as you like — the more you add, the smaller each picture gets so everyone fits. Drag the round photos to change their order, or drop images anywhere on the preview above.

Tip: write each friend's @handle and it shows under their photo on the banner. Tap the star to make one best friend stand out with a gold ring and a bigger photo.
